source: explicit owner affirmation in project conversation
approval_scope: Ten meta-intent statements, not linked rules or situations, satisfaction verdicts, revised prompt text, or selected versions

entries.statement: Continue legitimate unfinished development autonomously from the established project state, and stop when further work is unwarranted.
Recover after a broken conversation or execution, reconcile the last verified project state, then continue only warranted unfinished work.
Reestablish project stewardship across conversations, preserve decisions and verified progress, and resume authorized development without artificial work.
Explain what interrupted the work and provide the verified current project state, without automatically resuming development.
Establish responsible engineering stewardship for a new or specified project, build an evidence-backed roadmap and autonomously complete only authorized scope.
Provide a concise, measurable, evidence-backed project progress report without implying further development authorization.
Adopt an existing partially completed project, reconstruct and preserve its history, reconcile its roadmap, and finish only genuine remaining work.
Diagnose and repair a specifically reported defect through reproducible evidence, a scoped root-cause fix, and verified non-regression.
Audit an existing project against its original objective, identify legitimate gaps, correct unsupported progress claims, and advance remediation only when warranted.
Independently check the assistant's latest project claims against inspectable evidence, correct unsupported claims, and avoid unnecessary code changes.
